acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Bears family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Scarback, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Terrain-Breaker Champion archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Huge scarred bear with splintered debris caught in its coat and a recognizable pale scar across the back.
Signature mechanic: Falling Territory: Scarback tests one structure, topples it into a fixed lane, then follows through the debris.
battlefieldDuty: Bring down a tree, pillar, or boulder as moving cover before charging through the debris.
constructionDimensions: Dense fur, hide, claws, breath, mud, splinters, and scars remain mundane and tactile.
Weight reads through shoulder compression, paw spread, disturbed ground, and slow recovery rather than supernatural mass.
counterplay: Leave the fall lane or attack the planted hind legs before the structure gives way. Affinity signal: The raised shoulder, open inner wrist, planted hind leg, stretched back scar, or marked den shoulder remains visible before commitment.
forbiddenTreatments: Elemental glow or unexplained magical anatomy
Humanoid weapons, clothing, or plate armor
identityInvariants: Every form retains a four-legged ursine body, plantigrade paws, compact tail, broad muzzle, dense coat, and weight-bearing shoulder hump.
Escalation uses coat condition, scars, claw specialization, posture, and environmental interaction rather than humanoid equipment.
Raised shoulders, planted hind legs, open chest, and exposed inner wrists preserve readable commitment and recovery windows.
telegraph: Its broad back scars stretch while both forepaws test the chosen structure.
